template.text:
Hey there, I’m Frankie 👋

Think of me as your FS person. I know what’s happening on Campus, networking hotspots, the stuff you might miss on Canvas, and where to find the food.

Let’s get to know each other so I can share what’s useful for you.

Hey there, welcome to FS! I’m so glad to have you here 💙

I’ll keep you updated on everything OW-related: how to register for all the activities, what’s coming up, and send you your daily schedules once it kicks off. After that, I’ll help you navigate your next steps at FS.

If you have any questions about OW or FS in general, now or later, just ask!

Your first week at FS is about to begin! 🥳 

🎟️ For now, I’m sending over your first *digital ticket* - you’ll be getting it in the next half an hour!
You will need the ticket for your in-person, Opening Week registration 🧾


But not to worry - you’ll hear from me throughout the week for all the daily details. ☺️

If there’s anything you need, I’m here 💙

Hey! 👋
I’ll be taking a short daily break while my developers finish a system upgrade. I’ll be back tomorrow around 12 PM, refreshed and better than ever.

We’re back ✨
The upgrade is done and I’m ready to help. Feel free to ask me anything!

Good luck with exams, <first_name> 🙌

In between all the stress, there are some great events coming up you can look forward to:

🚀 Space Club Kitchen: Dinner & networking with ESA, business and innovation leaders • Thu, 29 May • 18:30

🪩 StuCo Semester Closing Party @ Pier 1: “Night of the Profs” with professors behind the DJ booth • Fri, 30 May • 22:00–04:00

Let me know if you’d like to know more.

Hey <first_name>, just a quick note from me 💙

Following this week's incident, we want to reassure you that the situation was handled immediately and there is no ongoing threat to campus safety. As an extra precaution, temporary security measures have been put in place, so please remember to bring your FS Card, or a national ID together with your Immatrikulationsbescheinigung for campus access.

We know situations like this can feel a little unsettling, so check in on yourselves and your friends tonight 💙

info.user_text: Do classes officially start on 25. Of august or 1. Of september
info.text:
Classes for the Master of Finance program officially start on August 25, 2025. 
 Before that, there are Prep Courses from August 1 to August 23, 2025, followed by an Orientation Week from August 25 to August 30, 2025. 
 Excited to kick off this academic adventure? 🚀

info.user_text: Am I supposed to birng guests to the opening ceremony? Or is it a student only event? Will i get more tickets for my guests as well?
info.text:
The Opening Ceremony is a special event primarily for new Master's students to kick off their academic journey at FS. Unfortunately, it's designed as a student-only event, so additional tickets for guests aren't available. But don't worry, there will be plenty of other opportunities throughout the year to bring guests and share your FS experience! 🎓🎉

If you have any more questions or need further details, feel free to ask! 😊

info.user_text: Is the student help desk open on saturdays?
info.text:
Yes, the Student Help Desk is open on Saturdays from 09:00 to 13:00.  
Feel free to drop by if you need any assistance!

info.user_text: If i want to go to the review session for my exams from q1, do i have to be at uni in person or can i do it online as well?
info.text:
For exam review sessions, you'll need to be present in person at the university. 
 Each exam can only be reviewed during its respective session, so make sure to mark your calendar! 🗓️ 
 If you have any more questions or need assistance, feel free to ask!

info.user_text: How can i print things in the library
info.text: Here's how: Log into Onlime Campus, select My Profile, then Login data workstation, and set a password of your choice. Save it, and you're ready to go!

info.user_text: How can i print things in the library
info.text: Just lay your card on the card reader at one of the printers and enter your password. After that, printing will be as easy as pie! 🍰

info.user_text: ok but how do i send the documents that need to be printed to the printer
info.text: Simply email your documents to mp@fs.de or mobileprinting@fs.de. Then head over to any printer on campus, swipe your student card on the card reader, select your print job, and choose "print + delete" or "print all." Voilà, your document will start printing!

info.user_text: can i send mutliple emails or do i have to send all the files in one email
info.text:
You can send multiple emails if you like! 📧✨ 
 Each email will queue up your documents for printing, so feel free to send them separately or all together. 
 Just make sure you swipe your card and select the print jobs you want when you're at the printer. Happy printing!

With the Campus Sorgenfrei Scholarship 2026, you have the chance to receive *1,000 EUR* in financial support for your studies.

The best part: Your field of study and grade point average do not matter.

Apply now and enjoy a stress-free start to the 2026/27 winter semester.

Here’s how to secure your chance for a worry-free study experience:
- Register on Santander Open Academy
- Complete the application form
- Submit your application by 20 November 2026
